qs.q: During skeletal development, an infant is diagnosed with achondroplasia. Which category of developmental anomalies does this condition belong to?
qs.e: Achondroplasia is classified as a skeletal anomaly alongside syndactyly and congenital hip dislocation. Neural tube defects involve the central nervous system.
